item.title: Opening Segment: Meet Guest Host Wayne Edwards; Make an Impact with Finally Family Homes
item.description: In the opening segment of SCVTV's Community Corner, we meet guest host Wayne Edwards, a former Major League pitcher who played for the Chicago White Sox and had a brief stint with the Los Angeles Dodgers. Edwards also shares what fueled his decision to work in law enforcement after his retirement from the MLB.
